purpose: Teach: 劣っ/裏返し/裏腹/正しかっ/小柄/可愛らしい/起っ/つくれ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんに体力で劣っても気持ちで勝つわよ
lines.en: Sho — even if your dad is smaller, you can win with heart where he's got strength.
lines.style: Warm, steady encouragement. Opens softly on the boy's name. Builds conviction gradually on 「気持ちで勝つ」. Maternal certainty without lecturing. Slight lift at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、シャツを裏返しに着てたよ
lines.en: Mom — I was wearing my shirt inside out the whole time.
lines.style: Small, mortified realization. Quiet voice. The sudden awareness of having looked foolish. Mild rue mixed with the dry humor of a perceptive child watching himself.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは見た目と裏腹に優しい方よ
lines.en: Sho — your dad is kinder than his appearance suggests.
lines.style: Gentle reassurance, as if correcting a small misconception with kindness. Warm tone. Spoken to soothe any worry the boy might have. No urgency — just steady maternal wisdom.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが「君が正しかった」って認めて下さったよ
lines.en: Mom — Dad actually admitted that I was right.
lines.style: Bright with pride and surprise. Eager to share something that felt significant to him. The warmth of a small triumph. Voice rises slightly on the word "right."

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは小柄でも頼もしいわね
lines.en: Sho — your dad is dependable, even if he's not tall.
lines.style: Satisfied observation. Quiet warmth. The voice of a mother pleased with a realization her son has had. Composed, affirming. No sentimentality — just matter-of-fact approval.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが可愛らしいお話して下さったよ
lines.en: Mom — Dad told me the sweetest story.
lines.style: Tender warmth with quiet delight. Soft opening on 「お父さんが」. The gentle eagerness of a child sharing something precious. Lingers on the memory. No rush.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お庭で虫が起ってきたわ、虫眼鏡で見ましょうね
lines.en: Sho — look, bugs are starting to come out in the garden. Should we look at them with the magnifying glass?
lines.style: Warm invitation. Gentle, observant tone. The voice of a mother noticing and wanting to share a small moment. Opens with calm interest, offers the activity like a quiet gift. Inviting without pressure.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとプラモデルをつくれて嬉しかったよ
lines.en: Mom — I was so happy that Dad and I built a model together.
lines.style: Quiet glow of contentment. Soft opening. The genuine warmth of a child recounting something simple that meant everything. Voice trails off slightly on the last word — savoring the memory.
